signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a red two-story colonial and its front lawn from the street; a large tree partially shades the upper left of the frame.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Lawn is mowed and there are small trimmed evergreens in a wooden planter box and a shrub by the house, but no crew, equipment, or clearly professional design is visible.

signals.notes: Detached red garage with open door sits left of the house, an American flag hangs from the porch, and a dark SUV is parked on the neighboring driveway at far left, so it may not belong to this property.
